name: ruling-9-a-value-that-wraps-to-another-case
reference: spec 0.56 ruling 9: 15 wraps to 5, which no case holds: else; y sets p.1 (80), x is not written, the absent key selects else, y is 07. Control: wrapped and unwrapped select alike. The held x is lost here by 0.8 (an if !p.1 block is not written when p.1 is 1), which 0.56 neither asks for nor changes.
